summary: Reviewed 31 units against the Sanskrit. Substance of the draft is sound (splits, cases, roots, ca/vā/eva rendered, paṇ/paṇita readings consistent). Issues: 2 error, 42 minor; 39 machine patches. Main points: Hindi 'और' used for bhūyaḥ (13, 22) and in 3-member lists (2, 26); yātavya/sama/pratāpa/dvaidhī-bhūta aligned with glossary 7.2/7.4/7.5; ekānta kept literal; the 'dd h' text_flags in 4, 11, 18, 29 are false positives (e-text habit) and must be removed by hand. Kept as drafted: pārṣṇi 'heel' in pārṣṇim grah / pārṣṇi-grāha and 'rear' in mūla-pārṣṇi (12.1); āsāra 'reinforcements' in vīvadha-āsārau (10.4) and 'reinforcer' as a thing crushed (unit 23, 6.2); doṣa 'defect'; paṇ 'strike a bargain'; daṇḍa army; sandhi treaty (12.1; 7.4/8.5 say peace, a person should align). No regrouping suggested. Hand edits: unit 2 last 'me' gram; remove text_flags in 4, 11, 18, 29.
